about: The shared button-2 add-ons. A stem names one by its id; the SC add-on library builds each one.

args.echo: echo send while held, at least (default 0.6)
args.room: room send while held, at least (default 0.2)
args.echoTime: own echo's time in beats while held (stem with echo)
args.echoFeedback: own echo's feedback while held (stem with echo)

riser.label: Riser
riser.about: a noise sweep rises while held.

args.bars: length of the rise in bars, 2 (default) or 4

roll.label: Roll
roll.about: a roll in 16ths, growing over the bar, while held.

fill.label: Fill
fill.about: a fill over the bar while held.

open.label: Open
open.about: the sound opens (brighter, longer) while held.

swell.label: Swell
swell.about: the stem swells up while held.

args.bars: length of the swell in bars, 4 (default)

stutter.label: Stutter
stutter.about: each beat's start repeats in 16ths while held.

ratchet.label: Ratchet
ratchet.about: each note repeats in quick 16ths while held.

burst.label: Burst
burst.about: a quick scatter of accents while held.

lift.label: Lift
lift.about: the stem grows, denser and brighter, while held.
